title: 19 April 2012: Paul McCartney live at Estadio El Campín, Bogotá, Colombia
content:
Paul McCartney performed at the Estadio El Campín in Bogotá, Colombia, on 19 April 2012.

It was the 26th show of the On The Run Tour, which lasted for 37 dates between July 2011 and November 2012.

There were some minor setlist changes, the most notable being the inclusion of ‘Things We Said Today’ and ‘Hope Of Deliverance’ midway through the concert.

McCartney’s band was Paul ‘Wix’ Wickens (vocals, keyboards, guitar, percussion, harmonica), Brian Ray (vocals, guitar, bass), Rusty Anderson (vocals, guitar), and Abe Laboriel Jr (vocals, drums).

McCartney returned to the Estadio El Campín on 1 November 2024 during the Got Back Tour.
